scenario.title: Escort and verify following
scenario.description: A scripted mobile actor follows the rover. A temporary follower pause makes the rover wait and reacquire.
scenario.expected_outcome: Returns with the actor verified in the launch zone, logging every following check.

final_observed_grid.note: Simulation only: 360-degree sensor; walls include one-cell clearance buffer

assumptions: Laptop simulation only; no Arduino, motors, or physical camera are controlled.
Robot routes are calculated by frontier exploration on observed free cells.
Sensing is an ideal 360-degree grid model, not the D435i camera.
Person/hazard markers and fault events are scripted synthetic fixtures, not model predictions.
The scenario author checks hidden-fixture connectivity when placing scripted obstacles; robot route planning still uses observations only.
Coverage is a hidden-fixture diagnostic, not proof that a real building was fully scanned.
No age, consciousness, mobility, or medical condition is inferred.
